name: patchclock-v1
run: cd /work && python pin_fetch.py > /out/pins_patchclock.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/pins_patchclock.txt; exit $rc

cd /work && G=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/munimtechnologies/psp-five-minute-test && curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o p5min.py $G/a025a506d2092e982e82e87c2c27e4f2a477fa98/psp5min/p5min.py && curl -fsSL --retry 3 -o psp5alf.py $G/f13f8d6dc800c9f5cf3212094a95d05a0e3dd2b0/alfven/psp5alf.py && printf '%s  %s\n' 310727b815768e4937f606d72814db4d4bcf9106aa9a9b2fe8f1fea6351d05a4 p5min.py 6fc3e1fb0cd04bde5ec75eec7aee87ebae444469b5dfa84d76b2252e80dac18d psp5alf.py > /tmp/pins.txt && sha256sum -c /tmp/pins.txt; rc=$?; python -m py_compile p5min.py psp5alf.py patchclock.py test_patchclock.py > /out/compile.txt 2>&1 || rc=1; cat /out/compile.txt; sha256sum p5min.py psp5alf.py patchclock.py test_patchclock.py PREREG-PATCH-v0.1.md | tee /out/sha256.txt; pip list 2>/dev/null | grep -iE '^(numpy|cdflib) ' | tee /out/versions.txt; echo "pins+compile rc=$rc"; exit $rc
cd /work && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 python -m unittest -v test_patchclock > /out/tests.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; cat /out/tests.txt; exit $rc

cd /work && OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 python patchclock.py --data-dir /data --out-dir /out --budget-s 12000 > /out/run.txt 2>&1; rc=$?; grep -E '^PCLK_(VERSION|PERIHELIA|HG|ENC|FIT|ROBUST|MODELFREE|INJ|GRADES|BUDGET)|^P5MIN_(TIMECHECK|WARN)|^PALF_WARN' /out/run.txt | head -n 260; tail -n 30 /out/run.txt; exit $rc
